subject: MAP & benchmark summary — sustained QPS, tokens/sec, unit economics, and close timeline
messages:
From: Ava Richardson <ava@finstream.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@finstream.com>
Date: 2026-03-25T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Follow-up: MAP and performance targets for procurement

Hi Diego,

Thanks again for the demo earlier today — the real-time routing examples were helpful. Procurement and the infra team have asked for a short Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that includes explicit performance targets and the evaluation plan we discussed:

- Latency targets (p50/p95), TTFT, and concurrency assumptions
- Sustained throughput targets (tokens/sec and QPS) for our 1k/4k token profiles
- A clear test matrix and sample scripts for us to reproduce results
- Unit economics: expected $/1M tokens and expected $/QPS-hour under both hosted and reserved pricing estimates

We need this to feed into our vendor scorecard and procurement timeline. Can you share a MAP with a benchmarking summary and proposed close timeline? We are aiming to finalize vendor selection by 2026-04-15.

Thanks,
Ava
Ava Richardson
Head of ML Platforms, FinStream

From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-26T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Follow-up: MAP and performance targets for procurement

Sergio / Marissa —

Ava asked for a MAP + benchmarking summary and an evaluation plan they can run. Proposal below: lightweight, reproducible set of tests + a business-facing MAP that ties milestones to measurable perf gates.

Proposed test matrix (we'll run both hosted + dedicated sim):
- Profiles: 1k token prompt + 256 token completion; 4k prompt + 512 completion
- Concurrency sweep: 1, 4, 8, 16 workers
- Metrics captured: TTFT (ms), p50/p95 token latency (ms), tokens/sec (sustained), sustained QPS (responses/sec), failed request rate
- Run length: warmup 10 minutes, sustained run 30 minutes per configuration

Deliverables to attach to MAP:
- benchmark-plan-20260326.pdf (test scripts + run steps)
- FinStream_MAP_v1.xlsx (milestones, owners, acceptance gates)
- throughput-results-20260330.csv (final numbers) — placeholder until we run

Timeline suggestion to meet their 2026-04-15 target:
- 2026-04-02: run canary (small footprint) with FinStream test harness
- 2026-04-09: pilot run (full sustained configs) + draft acceptance report
- 2026-04-13: incorporate procurement/contracting feedback
- 2026-04-15: procurement decision / signature

Sergio, can you own the runs and populate the csv? Marissa, please draft the MAP and acceptance criteria using the attached spreadsheet template.

Diego
Account Exec — Redwood Inference

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Ava Richardson <ava@finstream.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-28T14:40:00-07:00
Subject: MAP + evaluation plan and test artifacts (initial)

Hi Ava — attaching the MAP and the evaluation plan we discussed. High-level summary is below; attachments include the exact runner scripts and a canned k6 + python harness to replay your traffic shapes.

Attachment highlights:
- FinStream_MAP_v1.xlsx: MAP with milestones, owners, acceptance gates. Acceptance is sign-off when all gates pass on the pilot run.
- benchmark-plan-20260326.pdf: test matrix + commands to run our runner.

Performance gates we recommend for acceptance (pilot):
- TTFT (time to first token): <= 30 ms (hosted), <= 25 ms (dedicated).
- p50 token latency: <= 10 ms for small responses, <= 18 ms for 4k sequences.
- p95 token latency: <= 120 ms
- Sustained tokens/sec (per server config): 12k tokens/sec for 1k profile, 8k tokens/sec for 4k profile (measured over 30 minutes).
- Sustained QPS (responses/sec): target 85 qps for 1k profile, 30 qps for 4k profile at concurrency 8 (sustained).

Unit economics (estimates):
- Hosted (on-demand) estimate: $0.95 per 1M tokens (inference only) for 1k-profile average; expected cost per QPS-hour: ~$18 (varies by profile).
- Dedicated (reserved) estimate: effective unit costs drop ~30% at committed capacity; expected cost per QPS-hour: ~$12 under committed plan.

Next steps / ask:
1) Can FinStream run the attached harness on your infra (we provide small runner images)?
2) If preferred, we can run the pilot on a Redwood Dedicated pool and share logs/traces for transparency.

Attaching: FinStream_MAP_v1.xlsx; benchmark-plan-20260326.pdf

From: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@finstream.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>, Ava Richardson <ava@finstream.com>
Cc: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-29T11:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP + evaluation plan and test artifacts (initial)

Thanks Sergio — useful doc. A few clarifying questions from infra/procurement:

1) Your sustained tokens/sec numbers look good; can you confirm those were measured with KV cache enabled? Our workload will re-use prefixes (~35%) so caching could materially affect throughput.

2) We need a 95th percentile latency guarantee of <120ms at concurrency = 8 for the 4k profile to consider the SLA. Can you show an example run with the p95 number attached?

3) On unit economics: can you provide a per-1M-token blended price assuming our profile mix (70% 1k, 30% 4k) and a 12-month reserved commitment? Procurement needs a simple line item we can put into the SOW.

Finally, our target procurement milestone: internal approval by 2026-04-10 so we can issue a PO on 2026-04-12. If you can get a pilot run in the week of 2026-04-05, that would be ideal.

Tom
Infra Eng Lead — FinStream

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@finstream.com>, Ava Richardson <ava@finstream.com>
Cc: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-30T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: RE: MAP + evaluation plan and test artifacts (initial) — benchmark summary attached

Tom / Ava —

We completed an internal run that mirrors the matrix (KV cache enabled; same request mix). Summary (sustained 30-minute windows, after a 10-minute warmup):

1) 1k profile (70% mix)
- Concurrency: 8 workers
- Sustained tokens/sec (observed): median 11,600 t/s; 5th-95th range: 11,100 - 12,100
- Sustained QPS (responses/sec): 88 qps (steady)
- TTFT (time to first token): median 22 ms; p95 = 38 ms

2) 4k profile (30% mix)
- Concurrency: 8 workers
- Sustained tokens/sec (observed): median 8,050 t/s; 5th-95th range: 7,700 - 8,400
- Sustained QPS: 32 qps (steady)
- TTFT: median 24 ms; p95 = 112 ms

Comments: p95 for 4k at concurrency=8 measured 112 ms (with KV cache enabled on repeated prefixes). That meets your <120ms p95 ask. We saw the biggest variance during synthetic long-horizon sampling on a small subset of runs — traces attached.

Unit economics (blended model for 70/30 mix, sustained usage):
- Hosted (on-demand): ~$0.88 per 1M tokens (inference only) — blended. This converts to ~$16.50 per QPS-hour for your profile mix.
- Dedicated (12-month reserved commit): estimated $0.62 per 1M tokens (inference only) — blended. Estimated ~$11.50 per QPS-hour under typical utilization assumptions.
- Notes: these include kernel/quantization defaults used in the run (int8 quant). If you enable extra model safety hooks or use larger context quant settings, costs can rise ~10-18%.

Attached: throughput-results-20260330.csv (raw time-series), sample trace logs, and an updated FinStream_MAP_v1.xlsx with acceptance gates populated.

Proposed next steps to keep to your procurement timeline:
- 2026-04-05: Redwood runs canary with your harness (we provide runner and shared traces) — Diego to coordinate
- 2026-04-09: Pilot (full sustained configs) — results delivered same day
- 2026-04-10: FinStream internal approval target
- 2026-04-12: PO expected

Please confirm if we should provision Dedicated capacity for the pilot or if you will run the harness on your infra. If you confirm, we will prepare an SOW line item using the dedicated blended numbers above.
